policy.disagreement_decision: when the two direct answerers disagree, use option-quota Qwen3.5-27B only for compiler-v2 BEFORE and MULTI_TIME questions; otherwise retain endpoint Qwen3.5-27B

known_limitations: The route requires two Qwen3.5-27B answer passes and SigLIP2 frame selection for the option-quota branch.

The historical option-quota strategy retrieves one center per answer option and fills the remaining center budget from the combined question-and-options query; it is not the later balanced multi-center strategy.
